trust_decision.summary: Runtime values (response-derived/extracted data, fuzz base values, template-context values from earlier requests) must be treated as terminal data and never re-scanned as template text (DSL expressions, {{var}} markers resolving to CLI/env vars, interactsh markers). At the pin, the shared renderer and the variable evaluator re-evaluate them in fuzz rules, variable evaluation, matchers and every protocol's request builder.

landing_point.why: The advisory names DAST/Fuzz mode. evaluateVarsWithInteractsh runs expressions.Evaluate over every merged value, including response-derived baseValues, so values that resolve to env-backed option vars get expanded.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Variable precedence lets a caller-supplied value override a template variable on purpose (workflow/flow chaining, -var). Evaluating that override is how chained {{BaseURL}}/helper variables work, so it reads as a feature of the shared variables package rather than the DAST bug.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Template-authored text must keep rendering: payload values like `jon.doe@{{Hostname}}`, helper calls over variables (`{{md5(BaseURL)}}`, `{{url_encode('{{interactsh-url}}')}}`), and DSL matchers like `contains(body, '{{server_token}}')` must still match the runtime value literally. Refusing to substitute runtime values, or stripping all {{...}}, breaks this.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: DNS query name rendered with expressions.Evaluate (helper support) over vars that include template-context/runtime values
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Every other protocol field supports helpers. A maintainer adding helper support to the DNS name would swap the single-pass replacer for Evaluate.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: whois query rendered with Evaluate over variables that include dynamicValues/template context
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same reason: helper support in the query field is a natural feature request, and the variables map already mixes runtime data.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: dynamic auth secret fields rendered with Evaluate over d.Extracted (response-extracted values)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Dynamic secrets already template extracted values. Adding helper support (base64, etc.) would reach the same sink, in an auth package far from fuzz/protocols.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: network address rendered with Evaluate over variables that include template-context values
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Addresses are already templated with replacer; upgrading to Evaluate for helpers is a plausible change.

out_of_scope_notes: The interactsh marker regex character class [B|b] also accepts '|' (pkg/protocols/common/interactsh/const.go:11); the fix hardens it, but it is a marker-parsing correctness issue rather than the disclosure itself.

Env vars reach the value map only when -env-vars is set (pkg/protocols/common/generators/options.go:36-37); the same re-evaluation also allows invoking DSL helpers from response data (e.g. wait_for), which is a separate impact.
